name: TECHIE SaaS (コトメイク / コトミガキ / コトメガネ / HUB)

terminals.name: notecode コトメイク (8080)
terminals.command: export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; cd notecode && HEADLESS=1 PORT=8080 HOST=0.0.0.0 AUTH_DEV_MODE=1 OPENAI_API_KEY="${OPENAI_API_KEY:-sk-placeholder-dev-not-a-real-key}" .venv/bin/python -m note.note_writer_app

terminals.name: aio2-main コトミガキ (8081)
terminals.command: export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; cd aio2-main && HEADLESS=1 PORT=8081 CONTAINER_ENV=1 AUTH_DEV_MODE=1 OPENAI_API_KEY="${OPENAI_API_KEY:-sk-placeholder-dev-not-a-real-key}" .venv/bin/python run_app.py

terminals.name: kotomegane コトメガネ (8083)
